description.p: Nextpad++ is a multi-tab text editor for Linux, ported from the macOS Nextpad++ codebase (which is in turn a native port of the Windows Notepad++). Built on Scintilla and Lexilla with GTK 3.

ul.li: Multi-tab editing with drag-to-reorder, pinning, and per-tab settings
Syntax highlighting for 50+ languages via Lexilla
Find / Replace / Find in Files with regex support
Multiple side panels: Document List, Function List, Document Map, Folder-as-Workspace, Search Results, Character Panel, Clipboard History, Project
Hash generators (MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512) and MIME tools (Base64, ASCII↔Hex)
Plugin system compatible with the Notepad++ for macOS plugin SDK

description.p: Initial Linux release. Multi-tab editing, full find/replace, side panels, macros, plugin SDK, command palette.
